# Java customizations

Owners: Java SDK specialists (add GitHub handles here)

## Where handwritten code lives

### 1. Inline handwritten members in generated files

`@Generated` marks members that regeneration manages. The
[annotation's documentation](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-java/blob/038ef1fb1233d37579235c09a3a23959d308ac70/sdk/core/azure-core/src/main/java/com/azure/core/annotation/Generated.java#L14-L24)
describes preserving unannotated methods during regeneration. Treat this as a signal, not a
universal guarantee across generator configurations.

- A member **without** `@Generated` in a file whose other members have it is a candidate
  handwritten customization.
- A generated-file header does not mean every method is generated. A file can start with
  `Code generated by ... TypeSpec Code Generator` and still contain handwritten methods.

### 2. Customization scripts

Classes extending `com.azure.autorest.customization.Customization` (usually under
`customization/src/main/java/`) modify generated Java through AST edits: adding methods,
replacing bodies, changing visibility, updating Javadocs, and removing types. Each distinct
edit is a candidate instance. Some libraries also describe their customizations in a
`customizations.md` file.

## Signals

| Signal                                                                                                                 | Meaning                                                                      |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Member without `@Generated` next to members with it                                                                    | Inline handwritten member                                                    |
| Class extending `Customization`, `customization/` folder                                                               | Customization script                                                         |
| `addMethod`, `setBody`/`replaceBody`, `removeMethod`, `setModifiers`, `getJavadoc`, `removeAnnotation`, `rename` calls | Individual script edits                                                      |
| `customizations.md`                                                                                                    | Human description of customizations (useful context, not evidence by itself) |

## Not customizations

- Members annotated `@Generated`.
- Package-info files, `module-info.java`, and implementation helpers emitted by the generator.
- Tests and samples.

## Examples

| Library                                  | Source                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Handwritten customization                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ---------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **azure-ai-vision-imageanalysis**        | [`ImageBoundingBox.java`](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-java/blob/038ef1fb1233d37579235c09a3a23959d308ac70/sdk/vision/azure-ai-vision-imageanalysis/src/main/java/com/azure/ai/vision/imageanalysis/models/ImageBoundingBox.java)                                 | **Inline custom `toString()`.** Generated fields/getters carry `@Generated`, but this method does not. The [customization document explicitly identifies it as hand-added](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-java/blob/038ef1fb1233d37579235c09a3a23959d308ac70/sdk/vision/azure-ai-vision-imageanalysis/src/customizations/customizations.md#L1-L38). |
| **azure-ai-contentsafety**               | [`ContentSafetyImageData.java`](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-java/blob/038ef1fb1233d37579235c09a3a23959d308ac70/sdk/contentsafety/azure-ai-contentsafety/src/main/java/com/azure/ai/contentsafety/models/ContentSafetyImageData.java#L23-L79)                    | **Custom accessors inside a generated model.** `getContent()`/`setContent()` expose `BinaryData`, converting to/from the underlying `byte[]`. They lack `@Generated`, while neighboring members have it.                                                                                                                                                    |
| **azure-ai-contentsafety**               | [`ContentSafetyCustomization.java`](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-java/blob/038ef1fb1233d37579235c09a3a23959d308ac70/sdk/contentsafety/azure-ai-contentsafety/customization/src/main/java/ContentSafetyCustomization.java#L26-L37)                                | **Javadoc and annotation customization.** Rewrites a constructor's documentation and explicitly removes its `@Generated` annotation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **azure-search-documents**               | [`SearchCustomizations.java`](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-java/blob/038ef1fb1233d37579235c09a3a23959d308ac70/sdk/search/azure-search-documents/customizations/src/main/java/SearchCustomizations.java#L26-L99)                                                  | **Reshapes the public API.** Hides unwanted generated search methods, adjusts authentication scopes, preserves service versions, and adds typed convenience methods.                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **azure-messaging-eventgrid-namespaces** | [`EventGridCustomization.java`](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-java/blob/038ef1fb1233d37579235c09a3a23959d308ac70/sdk/eventgrid/azure-messaging-eventgrid-namespaces/customization/src/main/java/EventGridCustomization.java#L25-L65)                              | **Reuses a shared model.** Removes generated `CloudEvent`, redirects imports to Azure.Core's `CloudEvent`, and removes unwanted generated methods.                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **azure-resourcemanager-keyvault**       | [`KeyVaultCustomization.java`](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-java/blob/038ef1fb1233d37579235c09a3a23959d308ac70/sdk/keyvault/azure-resourcemanager-keyvault/customization/src/main/java/KeyVaultCustomization.java#L14-L60)                                       | **Compatibility fixes.** Changes generated model base classes from `ProxyResource` to `Resource` and restores a SKU default.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **azure-compute-batch**                  | [`BatchClientBuilderCustomization.java`](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-java/blob/038ef1fb1233d37579235c09a3a23959d308ac70/sdk/batch/azure-compute-batch/customization/src/main/java/BatchClientBuilderCustomization.java)                                         | **Adds an interface** to the generated builder: `AzureNamedKeyCredentialTrait<BatchClientBuilder>`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **azure-ai-documentintelligence**        | [`DocumentIntelligenceCustomizations.java`](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-java/blob/038ef1fb1233d37579235c09a3a23959d308ac70/sdk/documentintelligence/azure-ai-documentintelligence/customization/src/main/java/DocumentIntelligenceCustomizations.java#L59-L166) | **Rewrites convenience methods** to unpack options and call internal overloads; hides lower-level constructors and setters.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **azure-monitor-ingestion**              | [`MonitorIngestionCustomizations.java`](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-java/blob/038ef1fb1233d37579235c09a3a23959d308ac70/sdk/monitor/azure-monitor-ingestion/customization/src/main/java/MonitorIngestionCustomizations.java#L98-L154)                            | **Customizes authentication.** Adds an audience field/setter and replaces pipeline construction to use that audience in bearer-token authentication.                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
